thread:
priya: quick RFC follow-up — I'm calling this one the 'scalpel rollout' idea: canary with a micro-budget and preflight dry-run to catch regressions before any traffic moves. want tradeoffs and an API sketch.
theo: micro-budget? like reserve X requests to validate before wider ramp?
priya: exactly. controller allocates a small request budget B per minute to the canary (not just a %). runtime enforces both rate and deterministic assignment. if budget exhausted, controller pauses progression.
nora: interesting. that helps low-traffic routes where % ramps don't exercise variant. how do we prevent bias in request selection?
priya: two levers: 1) reservoir sampling of incoming requests to select diverse probes, 2) deterministic hashing for session stability. combine both: do reservoir picks for initial B, then sticky-hash for sustained fraction f(t).
lia: runtime cost? reservoir sampling per-route could add memory. maybe do light-weight reservoir with fixed K per-route and export sample snapshots for analysis.
theo: health signals? propose three classes: safety (5xxs, crash), perf (p95/p99), and semantic (semantic-score delta when available). controller evaluates each and computes an outcome enum PASS/WARN/FAIL.
nora: fail behavior: immediate rollback vs pause and retry? I'd prefer a pause+dry-retry then rollback to reduce flapping. we can keep a retry_count R in policy.
priya: good catch. policy fields: {route, variant, baseline, budget_per_min, sustained_frac, smoothing_window_s, affinity, retry_count, abort_conditions, fallback_variant, signature}. controller validates signature, performs preflight dry-run (see below), then activates.
lia: what's preflight dry-run? simulated traffic against canary with replay or synthetic probes before flipping live traffic?
priya: two modes: replay historical inputs (if allowed) or run synthetic probe suite (small eval of representative prompts). result fed into controller as preflight signals. preflight must PASS before any live budget is consumed.
theo: deploy-bot: [bot] preflight 1809992000: replay failed on 12/100 samples (semantic drift) — https://ci/redwood/preflight/1809992000
opsbot: [bot] canary run 1809993000 summary: budget_peak=60req/min, p95_delta=+5ms, err_delta=0.08% https://deployments/redwood/1809993000
nora: ps: we should add a budget-exhaustion metric so Console can show when canary is starved vs when it's healthy.
priya: state machine: PREFLIGHT -> LIVE_MICRO -> HOLD -> RAMP -> STABLE or ROLLBACK. transitions gated by budget health and preflight results.
lia: security: policy signature required for Dedicated/Private. runtime verifies signature + issuer ACL. also allow local-override toggle for emergency ops.
theo: UX: Console should show budget consumption (B/min), sampled probe examples, preflight pass rate, and a small timeline of f(t) vs budget_used. also an action to "force-advance" after human review.
nora: telemetry contract: runtime sends batched windows: {window_start, window_end, variant, requests, errs, p50,p95,p99,probe_examples_hash}. keep it compact.
priya: sample policy JSON (signed by control plane) — included here as a string in thread to show wire shape: 
```json
{"route":"/v1/chat","variant":"v4-alpha","baseline":"v3","budget_per_min":50,"sustained_frac":0.02,"smoothing_window_s":120,"affinity":"sticky-hash","retry_count":2,"abort_conditions":{"err_pct":0.5,"p95_ms":200,"semantic_drop":0.08},"fallback_variant":"v3-quant","run_id":"1809993000","signature":"<ed25519 sig>"}
```
lia: one more: add min_probe_diversity to ensure reservoir picks come from distinct user buckets. otherwise probes might be correlated.
theo: operational note: when budget small, statistical confidence is low — make sure thresholds scale with sqrt(N) or use Bayesian priors. otherwise tiny noise triggers rollbacks.
nora: ops playbook snippet: on auto-pause/rollback, post Slack with: preflight report link, probe samples, budget usage graph, and buttons: [Pause Auto] [Force Advance] [Open Runbook]. include run_id.
priya: follow-ups: 1) define preflight probe corpus format + privacy constraints, 2) prototype tiny proto for signed policy + batched telemetry, 3) simulate budgeted canary on low-traffic route to tune thresholds.
lia: tagging eng-runtime + eng-platform for review. i'll mock a Console panel after we finalize the proto.
priya: thanks all — this diverges from classic % ramps but could reduce noisy rollouts on low-volume endpoints. reconvene after prototypes. end thread.
